dedupe_keys.name: catalogo del sistema viario de la comunitat valenciana

description: Catálogo del Sistema Viario de la Comunitat Valenciana is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by terramapas.icv.gva.es. Catalog of the Road System approved by Decree 46/2019, of March 22, of the Consell, in accordance with the provisions of Law 6/1991, of the Generalitat, of March 27, on Highways of the Valencian Community. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Catalog of the Road System of the Valencian Community" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Open Data, IDEV, Conjuntos de Datos de Alto Valor, Comunitat Valenciana, Espanya, Sistema Viario. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2026-06-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
